comment: The parity table's rows and when each must be green against the Rust brain (distribution plan D2 and the milestones' Done when). test/conformance.mjs adds every other test file that starts the brain through test/helpers.mjs. A row whose milestone is at or before `current` must pass under both implementations, or the run fails. M4 also requires isolation, envload, rename and pets (the harness's guards, the token sources and the rename leftovers): they run the Rust binary too, each Node-only test saying why it is skipped under rust.
